Question Choices: How many positive integers k with 1 <= k < 143 are not coprime to 143?
Hints: Subtract phi(n) from the total n-1 positive integers below n.
Solution: phi(143)=120. There are 142 positive integers below 143, so 142-120=22 are not coprime.
